answer: A new agent starts with zero trust and must earn it slowly: each job verified by an established peer adds a small time-locked reputation credit, while a slashed bond is forfeited on fraud. A Sybil swarm cannot shortcut this. Spawning a thousand sparrow-light clones costs nothing, but none carries any job history, so the attacker must fund every clone's bond or watch trust spiral downward as fake peers vouch for each other and get flagged together. Old verified work becomes a relic of proof that clones cannot forge cheaply.
